attributes.name: face_to_face
attributes.text: The two people stand facing each other.
attributes.definition: The fronts of both torsos point toward each other during the main phase.

attributes.name: side_or_behind_partner
attributes.text: One person stands beside or behind the other.
attributes.definition: One person is next to or behind the partner, facing the partner's side or back rather than the front.

attributes.name: hands_meet_between
attributes.text: The hands of both people meet in the space between them.
attributes.definition: A hand of each person reaches forward and the hands come together between the two bodies.

attributes.name: fast_strike_to_partner
attributes.text: The actor moves a limb quickly into the partner's body.
attributes.definition: An arm or leg of one person travels quickly toward the partner and reaches the head, torso, or legs of the partner.

attributes.name: partner_recoils
attributes.text: The partner jerks back, leans away, or steps back in reaction.
attributes.definition: Right after the actor's movement, the partner's head or torso moves away from the actor, or the partner steps backward.

attributes.name: partner_raises_arms_to_block
attributes.text: The partner raises the arms in front of the body or head.
attributes.definition: The partner lifts one or both arms in front of the head or chest in response to the actor.

attributes.name: distance_decreases
attributes.text: The two people move closer together.
attributes.definition: The distance between the two bodies shrinks over the action.

attributes.name: distance_increases
attributes.definition: The distance between the two bodies grows over the action.

attributes.name: walk_same_direction
attributes.text: Both people walk in the same direction.
attributes.definition: Both people take steps and travel the same way while keeping a similar distance between them.

attributes.name: torsos_in_contact
attributes.text: The two bodies are pressed close with arms around each other.
attributes.definition: The torsos are touching or nearly touching and at least one arm wraps around the other person's back, shoulders, or waist.

attributes.name: both_do_same_motion
attributes.text: Both people perform the same movement at the same time.
attributes.definition: The two skeletons show matching movements in parallel, rather than one acting and the other reacting.

attributes.name: no_contact_at_distance
attributes.text: The two people stay apart without touching.
attributes.definition: Throughout the action no joint of one person comes close to the other person's body.
